name: soundcloud-recommender
description: A local, read-only listening companion that turns an explicitly supplied preference profile and a connected SoundCloud account into private, rule-based recommendations.

interface.shortDescription: Private, read-only listening discovery from a local viewer.
interface.longDescription: Listening Companion connects to SoundCloud only after explicit local authorization. It performs deterministic, rule-based discovery locally and returns the model only an app-owned result ID, count, status, and loopback viewer URL. Provider metadata remains in the authenticated local viewer and in-memory session cache.
defaultPrompt: Show my recent listening results in the local viewer.
Recommend podcasts from my saved preference profile.
Search for listening ideas without exposing provider metadata.
